note: These are next-build requirements, not 12 tests Astra passed. Independent executed tests are in evidence/independent-tests.log.

cases.title: Cold baseline
cases.procedure: A new isolated context, ordinary RAF/controller, no recording, production buffer settings. Export raw intervals including initial preparation separately.
cases.expected: Actual source/renderer/device/drawing-buffer IDs and all sample outliers; no captured-smoothness claim.

cases.title: Causal hitch diagnosis
cases.procedure: Trace one repeatable first-encounter stall with light-slot/program event markers. Compare an equivalent minimally observed run.
cases.expected: Measured cause or clearly unresolved hypothesis; no unsupported blame assigned to accessory, OS or GPU.

cases.title: Stable lighting variants
cases.procedure: Cross 55m practical boundaries and prepared kit power/equip changes.
cases.expected: No repeated new program compilation driven solely by slot count; emitting and resident slots counted separately.

cases.title: Preparation and race timing
cases.procedure: Load cold config and start countdown after preparation.
cases.expected: Preparation timed and visible, no throttle/race time consumed before ready; unchanged valid result and reward rules.

cases.title: Visible night upgrade
cases.procedure: Matched stock/red/cyan normal near-chase at streetlit and less-lit poses, plus ordinary motion.
cases.expected: Clear localized installed-color difference without exposure/world-light/material changes or billboard/bloom trick.

cases.title: Saved product behavior
cases.procedure: Owned build reload, temporary comparison, light power/color/brightness, preview cancel and night entry.
cases.expected: No duplicate charges/receipts; all durable settings preserved; unowned preview never reaches playable equipment.

cases.title: First lap and immediate retry
cases.procedure: Stock/equipped full-course runs in real time, including cold first playable lap then warm retry.
cases.expected: On named 4080 target host: planned p95<=20ms, p99<=33.4ms, no app-attributed >100ms. All outliers retained and actual limits disclosed.

cases.title: Production versus recorder
cases.procedure: Separate short real-time video run after scored no-recording measurements.
cases.expected: Unedited elapsed-time motion; no controlled-clock substitute; recorder impact and audio provenance explicit.

cases.title: Bounded resources
cases.procedure: Repeated on/off, equip, camera and scene operations after warmup.
cases.expected: Stable resource/program residency with no leaked emitters; no new per-vehicle shadow maps.

cases.title: Foundation retained
cases.procedure: Hash current car/rear/driver/route/contact/physics/audio and compare matched cosmetic on/off inputs.
cases.expected: Unchanged assets/rules and matching physics; any allowed integration changes itemized.

cases.title: Local tests/build
cases.procedure: Run existing full and focused tests plus changed-light lifecycle checks on actual source.
cases.expected: Real logs/versioned results; pending or mocked cases not counted as browser/hardware passes.

cases.title: Honest result
cases.procedure: Review final ordinary render and profile without expanding scope.
cases.expected: At most two evaluated fix cycles; return best state and explicit residual holds; G3/G4 remain pending.
